title: Microsoft Teams: delegators can lock calls and enable a delegate join tone
summary: The rollout, user controls, licensing caveats and documented delegation commands are supported. One enforcement claim needs removing: Microsoft does not state that switching off delegation in a calling policy prevents every use of the new lock and warning tone, and explicitly requires separate cleanup of existing delegation relationships.

claims.quote: Delegators can lock and unlock ongoing calls and can enable or disable the warning tone notification setting for delegate participation.

claims.claim: The general delegation toggle is at Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Delegation for inbound and outbound calls.
claims.quote:
select **Voice** > **Calling policies**.
2. Choose the policy you would like to update or select **Add** to create a new policy.
3. Toggle **Delegation for inbound and outbound calls** on.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy accepts Identity and Boolean AllowDelegation to control delegation generally.
claims.quote:
[-Identity] <string>
[-AllowDelegation <boolean>]
Enables the user to configure delegation in the Microsoft Teams client and that inbound calls to be routed to delegates

claims.claim: AllowDelegation is on by default.
claims.quote: You enable delegation by using the **TeamsCallingPolicy AllowDelegation** setting. You can use Teams admin center or Teams PowerShell. This setting is turned on by default.

claims.claim: Per-user calling and delegation settings are on Teams admin center > Users > Manage users > user > Voice.
claims.quote:
In the Teams admin center, go to **Users** > **Manage users** and select a licensed user.
6. On the user details page, go to the **Voice** tab.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls table; Risk assessment
claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams Set-CsUserCallingDelegate accepts Identity, Delegate and the five printed Boolean permission parameters to change an existing delegate's permissions.
claims.quote: Set-CsUserCallingDelegate -Identity user1@contoso.com -Delegate user2@contoso.com -MakeCalls $false -ReceiveCalls $true -ManageSettings $false -PickUpHeldCalls $true -JoinActiveCalls $true

claims.claim: JoinActiveCalls governs whether the specified delegate may join active calls for that user.
claims.quote: Specifies whether delegate is allowed to join active calls on behalf of the specified user.

claims.claim: PickUpHeldCalls is a permission assigned to the specified delegate to pick up calls for the user.
claims.quote:
### -PickUpHeldCalls

Specifies whether delegate is allowed to pick up calls on behalf of the specified user.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises cleaning up delegation relationships in Teams admin center when turning off delegation for a user.

claims.where: Governance controls: paragraph beginning 'The two documented rows'
claims.claim: Turning delegation off in the calling policy removes any use of the new lock and warning tone controls.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams AllowDelegation false existing delegates join active calls disabled policy lock. Read user-call-settings, Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy and teams-calling-policy. None states this effect on the new controls; user-call-settings separately requires cleanup of existing relationships.
claims.fix: Remove 'and with it any use of the new controls'. Replace the sentence with: 'The calling policy controls delegation generally, not the lock or tone individually. When turning delegation off, Microsoft also requires cleanup of the user's delegation relationships in Teams admin center to avoid incorrect call routing.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-call-settings.

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends assigning delegates and delegators the same calling policy.
claims.quote: Therefore, it's recommended that delegates and delegators are assigned the same calling policy.

claims.claim: A delegate is bound to their own calling policy rather than inheriting the delegator's calling policy permissions.
claims.quote: the delegate is bound to the settings configured in their calling policy and the permissions of the delegator's calling policy are not transferred to the delegate.

claims.claim: Neither the notice nor Learn explains the interaction between the per-call lock and JoinActiveCalls or PickUpHeldCalls permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegate warning tone default off per delegate lock Mac phone JoinActiveCalls interaction. Read Set-CsUserCallingDelegate, user-call-settings and MC1429012; no interaction with the new lock is stated.

claims.claim: The notice calls the warning tone optional but does not state whether it defaults to off for every user.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams delegate warning tone default off per delegate lock Mac phone JoinActiveCalls interaction. Read MC1429012 and user-call-settings; the notice says 'optional' and 'When enabled' but supplies no universal initial tone value.
